verdict.rationale: Exa documents background-style automation: scheduled searches that surface new web events (exa-docs-10), async deep research, list building and enrichment (exa-docs-9), and Websets that search, verify and enrich on their own (exa-docs-15, exa-docs-28). Real-time HTTP callbacks fire as items are added or enriched (exa-docs-21). However, scheduling appears only as a one-line pricing mention, and one hands-on report describes a Webset stuck in 'Verifying...' for minutes (exa-comm-3), which raises questions about how reliably runs complete unattended. Missing for 10: detailed docs on configuring schedules/monitors and their cadence, management of recurring background jobs, and independent corroboration of reliable autonomous runs.
